reference: A friend asked whether he had read all those books himself.
sk: Kamarát sa spýtal, či všetky tie knihy prečítal sám.
cz: Kamarád se zeptal, jestli všechny ty knihy přečetl sám.
acceptable: {A|My} friend asked {whether|if} he had read {all those|all of those|all the} books {himself|by himself|on his own}.
{A|My} friend asked {whether|if} he himself had read {all those|all of those} books.

mistakes.text: A friend asked {whether|if} he has read all those books himself.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po minulom „asked“ sa čas posúva dozadu: „he had read“, nie „he has read“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po minulém „asked“ se čas posouvá dozadu: „he had read“, ne „he has read“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After past “asked”, move the tense back: “he had read”, not “he has read”.

mistakes.text: A friend asked {whether|if} had he read all those books himself.
mistakes.feedback_sk: V nepriamej otázke je poradie ako vo vete oznamovacej: „whether he had read“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: V nepřímé otázce je pořadí jako v oznamovací větě: „whether he had read“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Reported questions keep statement word order: “whether he had read”.

mistakes.text: A friend asked {whether|if} did he read all those books himself.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Reported speech nepoužíva „did“: „whether he had read“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Reported speech nepoužívá „did“: „whether he had read“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Don't use “did” in a reported question: “whether he had read”.

mistakes.text: A friend asked {whether|if} he read all those books himself.
mistakes.kind: Past Simple instead of Past Perfect
mistakes.feedback_sk: Čítanie bolo pred otázkou, preto je lepší Past Perfect: „had read“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Čtení bylo před otázkou, proto je lepší Past Perfect: „had read“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The reading came before the question, so the Past Perfect “had read” is better.

mistakes.text: A friend asked {whether|if} he had read all this books himself.
Friend asked {whether|if} he had read all those books himself.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pred „friend“ chýba člen alebo zámeno: „A friend“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Před „friend“ chybí člen nebo zájmeno: „A friend“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Friend” needs an article or possessive here: “A friend”.
